summary.text: Ashley Carrick has served in the Alaska House of Representatives for District 35 since 2023.

paragraphs.text: According to her legislative biography, she moved from Anchorage to attend the University of Alaska Fairbanks, where she earned a bachelor's degree in psychology, and received a master's degree in public health from the University of Alaska Anchorage in 2020.

The biography says she worked for six years as a legislative aide, five of them as chief of staff to Representative Adam Wool, and was previously executive director of the Tanana Valley Watershed Association.
